spike_ext.note: z is measured from the bottom of the header pins (8.5 mm below the PCB); USB-C sits on the PCB top.
spike_ext.plug_note: plug = USB Type-C non-locking plug overmold maximum per the USB-IF Type-C Compliance Document rev 1.2, p. 46 (printed p. 38): width 12.35 max, height 6.5 max, with a 6.65 mm plug in front of it. Any compliant non-locking plug fits; locking Type-C plugs are larger and not supported. Type-C spec R2.0 §3.10.3 (Fig. 3-80, informative) has the seated overmold clear the product surface, so the opening passes the overmold.
